topics.topic: Cleanup or retention of a stored image when the placement-record write fails
questions: If the stored image is written successfully but writing its placement record fails or the process crashes, must the image be removed so the failed delivery writes nothing, or may an unrecorded image remain as implied by the mandated image-before-record order?
If storing the image succeeds but writing the placement record fails, may the stored image remain, or must it be removed so that the failed result wrote nothing except the lock?

When the stored image has been committed and writing the placement record then fails, must the image be removed to satisfy “nothing is written,” or may it remain as implied by the required image-before-record order and crash behavior; and which module owns any cleanup?

quotes:
5. A photo that cannot be delivered is answered with status `failed` and one member of
   `= models.PlacementFailure`, and nothing is written except the project lock:

6. The stored image is written before the placement record, so a crash between them repeats the
   placement and leaves no record without an image.
judgement.divergence: After the image is stored and the placement-record write fails, one behavior removes or leaves no stored image; the other leaves the stored image without a placement record. The operator and a caller retrying delivery notice the difference.
judgement.why: The unconditional no-write result for a failed photo conflicts with the expressly admitted durable state between the image and record writes.
